checks.name: owner inventory and targeted revocation
observations: Signed in through the Settings owner-session form; the returned inventory identified the browser's current session without exposing credential or nonce data.
A second isolated browser context signed in and appeared as an Active session in the owner's inventory.
Selected only the second session, checked the explicit single-session confirmation, re-entered the owner credential, and received the Selected session revoked receipt.
The refreshed inventory contained only the current owner session.
The second browser reloaded Settings and returned to the sign-in form, confirming that its revoked session no longer authorized the view.

checks.name: runtime and console after stable app restart
observations: The isolated app remained available throughout the successful end-to-end flow.
No new browser console errors were observed after the stable app restart; errors from earlier attempts corresponded to the documented bounded launcher stopping during browser-tool startup.

limitations: This is scoped browser acceptance for owner session inventory and single-target revocation, not independent security acceptance.
Other authenticated workflows, manual screen-reader review, deployment controls, provider compliance and all P00-P13 release gates remain open.
